scope: Corollary 5.2 of the manuscript “Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds” (preprints/Uniform-effective-log-Iitaka-fibrations-for-fourfolds-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8036215575dbf619), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose a dominant rational map between two ambient varieties sends generic movements of an upper family list to generic movements of a lower family list, or to stationary steps. Then the image of a generic upper leaf is contained in the corresponding lower leaf. If a finite group preserves a family list on V and θ : V → V′ is its quotient, the subvarieties θ(Hp) are the closures of the geometrically integral generic fibres of a rational fibration on V′.
